clue.text: Happen to take in a specific item getting children into the sea — such as this?

definitions.text: Happen to take in a specific item getting children into the sea — such as this?

indicators.note: to take in means to hold inside, so the word for happen wraps round everything that follows

parts.note: to happen is to be, as in 'so be it'
a thing is a specific item or object

indicators.note: children are put into the sea, so CH goes inside the word for the sea

parts.note: the main is an old word for the open sea

explanation.surface: A seaside question about some contraption used to get youngsters into the water.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: a bathing machine was a wheeled hut rolled into the sea so Victorian bathers could enter the water discreetly.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheeled changing hut, rolled into the shallows at Victorian resorts, carried swimmers including children straight into the water.

clue.text: Nothing acceptable in error of a literary nature

indicators.note: in tells us the nothing and acceptable pieces sit inside the word for error

parts.note: bish is British slang for a blunder or mistake
nothing is zero, the letter O
OK means acceptable

explanation.surface: A literary critic finds nothing acceptable in a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: BISH is informal British slang for a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone studious and fond of reading, rather than practical, is described with this adjective about literature.

clue.text: Source of items hot off the press?

definitions.text: Source of items hot off the press?

parts.words: Source of items hot off the press?
parts.note: 'hot off the press' usually means freshly published news, but here the items really are hot, printed by a device that uses heat on special paper

explanation.surface: Where do the latest newspaper stories come from?
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'hot off the press' suggests journalism; read literally, it describes receipts and labels produced by a heat-based printing device.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of device prints by heating coated paper, so its output emerges literally warm from the mechanism.

clue.text: Meal without starter — feeding such a man?

definitions.text: Meal without starter — feeding such a man?

indicators.note: without starter means the first letter of the meal word is dropped

parts.note: dinner is a main meal of the day

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a meal with no first course is enough to feed a certain man.
explanation.walkthrough: To feed 'the inner man' is an idiom for satisfying one's appetite, so a meal minus its first letter fits that man exactly.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'the inner man' means one's stomach or appetite, which a meal is meant to satisfy.

clue.text: Promise advance payment — argue hopelessly about that

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go round the payment word
hopelessly suggests the letters of argue are in a hopeless muddle

parts.note: an ante is a stake paid in advance in poker

explanation.surface: Someone argues hopelessly over a promised deposit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hopelessly' yields GUARE, which 'about' wraps round the stake; 'that' is only a link. In poker, a stake paid before the deal is the classic advance payment.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal assurance or pledge that something will happen is a synonym for a promise.

clue.text: See 1
A lot of inspiration surrounding a good sorcerer

indicators.note: surrounding means the shortened inspiration word goes round the other pieces
a lot of means most but not all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a muse is a source of inspiration

explanation.surface: A wizard draws plenty of inspiration from around him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A lot of' cuts MUSE to MUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A magus is a wise man or magician, so a synonym for a wizard or sorcerer.

clue.text: Hypocrisy and a sense of bitterness expressed in song

parts.note: cant is hypocritical, pious talk
bile is a sense of bitterness or ill temper

explanation.surface: A singer pours hypocrisy and bitterness into a song.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian musical direction means in a singing, lyrical style, as if voiced by a vocalist.

clue.text: Latin lingerie's distributed in dodgy marketing ploy

indicators.note: distributed means the letters are spread around and rearranged

explanation.surface: Mailing out Latin lingerie unasked counts as a shady sales trick.
explanation.walkthrough: The trick is to send goods unrequested and demand payment unless the recipient returns them, relying on their idleness.
explanation.definitionFit: This underhand sales tactic sends unordered goods and bills recipients who fail to return them.

clue.text: Cuts in energy repeated period of darkness

indicators.note: in tells us the cuts word goes inside the pair of energy letters
repeated means the energy letter appears twice

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy
clips are cuts, as when hair is clipped

explanation.surface: Repeated energy cuts lead to a period of darkness, like a series of blackouts.
explanation.definitionFit: When the Moon blocks the Sun, daylight briefly fails, giving a spell of darkness.

clue.text: Australian in a firm returning around Eastern Pacific region

indicators.note: around means the reversed string goes round the Eastern letter
returning means the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: An Australian working for a firm travels back around the Pacific.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns AINACO into OCANIA, and 'around' puts E inside after OC.
explanation.definitionFit: The name covers the islands of the central and south Pacific, including Australasia, a geographic area.

clue.text: Respectable information given to support Liberal

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
a tee is a support for a golf ball

explanation.surface: A respectable person is given information to back the Liberal party.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down-clue reading the support goes under; here 'given to support' simply places TEE before L.
explanation.definitionFit: Genteel describes polite, refined, socially proper behaviour, so it is a synonym for respectable.

clue.text: Smart limo on the move — such people are like gods

indicators.note: on the move means the letters shift into a new order

explanation.surface: Celebrities in a smart limousine travel as if they were divine.
explanation.definitionFit: Beings who never die, such as the deities of Olympus, are godlike.

clue.text: Perform badly, first to trip in a competition

indicators.note: in tells us the first letter of trip goes inside the competition phrase

parts.note: a cup is a competition, such as the FA Cup

indicators.note: first to means only the opening letter of trip is used

explanation.surface: A competitor performs badly after being the first to trip.
explanation.definitionFit: This phrasal verb means to misbehave or malfunction, which is performing badly.

clue.text: The man's mostly unwilling to be a slave

parts.note: the man is 'he', so the man's gives the pronoun

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: loth means unwilling or reluctant

explanation.surface: A man is largely unwilling to become a slave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The man's' reads as 'the man is', giving HE; 'to be a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A helot was a serf in ancient Sparta, so the word means a slave or bondsman.

clue.text: Italian conductor to read quickly in Italy

parts.note: to scan a text is to read it quickly
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: An Italian conductor reads a score quickly while in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Arturo Toscanini was a famous Italian orchestral conductor of the twentieth century.

clue.text: Stop recalling one number amongst 26

indicators.note: amongst means the reversed letters go inside the answer to 26

parts.note: 26 refers to the answer at 26-across, a wood-eating insect

indicators.note: recalling means calling back, so the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: A is one, as in 'a book'

explanation.surface: Stop going back over a single number in a list of twenty-six.
explanation.walkthrough: '26' looks like a number in the surface but is a cross-reference to the insect at 26-across; 'recalling' gives NA, which 'amongst' slots in after its first five letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring something to an end or halt is a synonym for stopping it.

clue.text: Relaxed, nursing muscle that's valued

indicators.note: nursing means holding something close, so one word contains another

parts.note: rested means relaxed
pec is short for pectoral, a chest muscle

explanation.surface: A relaxed athlete nursing a strained muscle is still prized by the team.
explanation.definitionFit: Something held in high regard or esteem is valued.

clue.text: Take back theatre: deficits initially cancelled with introduction of subsidy

parts.note: rep is short for repertory theatre

indicators.note: initially cancelled means the first letter is removed

parts.note: losses are deficits

indicators.note: introduction of means only the opening letter of subsidy is taken

explanation.surface: A theatre's debts are wiped once a subsidy arrives, but someone wants the building back.
explanation.definitionFit: Reclaiming goods whose payments have not been kept up is taking them back.

clue.text: Restraint in operating right lumberjack's tool for pollarding

indicators.note: pollarding cuts the top off a tree, so the word loses its top letter

parts.note: a hatchet is a small axe, a woodcutter's tool

explanation.surface: A lumberjack shows restraint in using the right tool to trim trees.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry the 'top' is the first letter, so pollarding removes H.
explanation.definitionFit: A toothed wheel with a pawl lets machinery turn one way only, a restraint on its movement.

clue.text: See 2
Most of group in front losing lead, having slowed down

indicators.note: in tells us the shortened group word sits inside the shortened front word
losing lead means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: the head is the front of something, as in the head of a queue

indicators.note: most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.surface: The leading group in a race loses its leader and eases off.
explanation.definitionFit: Having slackened or relaxed speed is a past-tense synonym for having slowed down.

clue.text: See 7
Dispute evidence of damage around orbiter

indicators.note: around means the damage word goes round the orbiter

parts.note: a dent is visible evidence of damage
the ISS, the International Space Station, orbits the Earth

explanation.surface: A dispute arises over damage done to a satellite.
explanation.definitionFit: Disagreement or objection to an official view is a synonym for dispute.

clue.text: Name encompassing one American forest region

indicators.note: encompassing means the name word surrounds the one

parts.note: a tag is a name or label
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A name taking in an American forest area.
explanation.definitionFit: The taiga is the swampy coniferous woodland belt of Siberia and the northern subarctic.

clue.text: Prince talks vaguely about English in opening remarks

indicators.note: about means the talk word goes round the English letter

parts.note: to ramble is to talk vaguely and aimlessly

explanation.surface: A prince waffles about England in his introductory speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Introductory statements before the main text or speech are its opening remarks.

clue.text: Tar's motion at sea?

definitions.meaning: tar is a black sticky substance, also called by this word
a ship rocking fore and aft in waves is said to do this

explanation.surface: A sailor's movement on the ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tar' is also slang for a sailor, which makes the surface about a seaman's motion.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the dark resinous substance and the bow-to-stern rocking of a vessel.

clue.text: Lesson millions needed before exam

parts.note: an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A lesson is that you need millions before sitting an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: The message a fable teaches is its lesson.

clue.text: Targets one time-line in history

indicators.note: in tells us the three letters go inside the history abbreviation

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Historians target one particular timeline.
explanation.definitionFit: A roster of people or things marked out for attack is a list of targets.

clue.text: Call it "the end of horticulture"?

parts.note: to term something is to call or name it

indicators.note: the end of means only the last letter of horticulture is taken

explanation.surface: Someone names a threat to gardening as horticulture's doom.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: these wood-eating insects can destroy garden timber and plants.
explanation.definitionFit: These wood-devouring insects can wreck garden structures and trees, so a gardener might call them the ruin of the craft.

clue.text: King tucking into this rude, peculiar, insubstantial sweetmeat

indicators.note: tucking into means the king letter is placed inside the shuffled letters
peculiar means odd, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
light means insubstantial or slight

explanation.surface: A king tucks into a strange, rude and flimsy confection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peculiar' gives TURISHDE, and 'tucking into' slips the king inside to make TURKISHDE; 'insubstantial' then supplies the second word.
explanation.definitionFit: This gel-like confection dusted with icing sugar is a classic sweet or candy.

clue.text: See 27
